train_GeoRTTrainer: train the GeoRTTrainer IK model using human hand data and a robot hand config
generate_robot_kinematics_dataset: generate a robot kinematics dataset with random joint positions and keypoint coordinates
get_robot_neural_fk_model: get or train a neural forward kinematics model from the GeoRTTrainer
get_robot_pointcloud: get the robot fingertip point cloud from the kinematics dataset via GeoRTTrainer
merge_dict_list: merge a list of dictionaries into a single dictionary with numpy array values
